description: This Java class defines a set of constant integer values representing column indices for fixed deposit import/export data handling within the Fineract project. It is used to map CSV or spreadsheet columns to specific fixed deposit attributes.

classes.name: FixedDepositConstants
classes.description: A final utility class that holds column index constants for fixed deposit data import/export, ensuring standardized reference to CSV column positions.
